description: Diagnostic (not in the paper): the Appendix D.2 RRWP GatedGCN baseline with the PR's original learning-rate schedule, cosine decay from 1e-3 to 1e-6 over the 200 epochs with no warmup, to test whether the schedule explains why the paper's RRWP baseline stays near chance while the constant-lr run solves the task in 3 of 4 seeds. Everything else is identical to synthetic_rrwp_original.json.
